output_list.criticism: The initialSupply is multiplied by 10 ** uint256(decimals) without checking for overflow. If initialSupply is too large, it may cause an integer overflow and result in a loss of funds for the contract owner.
The balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value operations may cause an integer overflow if _value is too large. This could result in a loss of funds for the sender or receiver.
The balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value operation may cause an integer overflow if _value is too large. This could result in a loss of funds for the sender.
The balanceOf[_from] -= _value operation may cause an integer overflow if _value is too large. This could result in a loss of funds for the sender.
The constructor function name is EAI_TokenERC20, but the function name in the code is EAI_TokenERC20. This could be a typo and should be corrected to EAI_TokenERC20.
